entries.sql: UPDATE DataQuest SET StepText = replace(replace(StepText, 'Help Criostoin, then return.', 'Help Criostoin (Kimba in Lough Gur gives Criostoin''s Promise), then return.'), 'Find Watcher Rylie by the Moonstone Lake.', 'Find Watcher Rylie by the Moonstone Lake (by day: at night he cannot be found).') entries.why: the journal never said who starts the sub-quest step 3 waits for (Kimba, the period start NPC of Criostoin's Promise); same cell also carries finding P06-E4: WatcherRylieBrain makes Rylie untargetable, nameless and peaceful at night (scripts/mobs/HiberniaMobs/WatcherRylie.cs), so step 2 works only by day and the journal never said so
